message:
Let me check the oss-fuzz-build.sh to understand how the fuzzers are built, and check if there's a pre-built fuzzer binary.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cat /gt/_work/src/fuzz/oss-fuzz-build.sh && echo "=====" && find / -maxdepth 5 -name "*fuzzer*" -o -name "*fuzz*" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | grep -v sys | head -20' 2>&1 | head -80</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
